_about: Issued share count per class, for issuers with more than one class of share. openinfo's charter capital gives the issuer's total (charter / par) but never the ordinary/preferred split, and its per-class list_shares are stale. An entry is used only while its classes' shares x par still add up to the charter capital openinfo publishes; once the charter moves, the entry stops fitting and the issuer's capitalisation is withheld until this file is updated. Counts are the exchange's own (uzse.uz /isu_infos/{isin}/detail, list_shrs), each checked against the charter on the day it was read.
